q_gram_c1_01_001.question: Ojalá ___ más tiempo libre el año pasado. (tener)
q_gram_c1_01_001.explanation: Dopo 'ojalá' referring a an unrealized past wish, il/la trapassato congiuntivo (hubiera + participio passato) è obbligatorio. 'Tuviera' sarebbe express a present contrary-a-fact wish, not a past one.

q_gram_c1_01_002.question: Quizás la situación ___ diferente si hubiéramos actuado antes. (ser)
q_gram_c1_01_002.explanation: 'Quizás' con il/la trapassato congiuntivo esprime doubt about a hypothetical past outcome. Il/la trapassato congiuntivo 'hubiera sido' è necessario perché il/la condition (si hubiéramos actuado) è anche in il/la trapassato congiuntivo.

q_gram_c1_01_003.question: Cosa does il/la congiuntivo dopo 'como si' express, e cosa tenses può follow esso?
q_gram_c1_01_003.correct: It expresses an unreal comparison; only the imperfect subjunctive or pluperfect subjunctive can follow 'como si'
wrong: It expresses a real comparison; the present subjunctive or indicative can follow
It expresses purpose; any subjunctive tense can follow 'como si'
It expresses a temporal relationship; only the present subjunctive follows
q_gram_c1_01_003.explanation: 'Como si' (as if) sempre introduces an unreal o hypothetical comparison. Spagnolo grammar restricts esso a il/la congiuntivo imperfetto (per present unreal) o il/la trapassato congiuntivo (per past unreal). Il/la congiuntivo presente è mai used dopo 'como si'.

q_gram_c1_01_004.question: Ella actúa como si no ___ nada de lo ocurrido. (saber, congiuntivo imperfetto)
q_gram_c1_01_004.explanation: Dopo 'como si', il/la congiuntivo imperfetto è obbligatorio per esprimere an unreal comparison in il/la present. 'Supiera' è il/la -ra form da il/la irregolare passato remoto radice sup-. Note: 'supiese' è anche grammatically valid ma il/la -ra form è il/la expected answer qui.
q_gram_c1_01_004.conjugation_info: saber (imperfect subjunctive): supiera, supieras, supiera, supiéramos, supierais, supieran

q_gram_c1_01_005.question: Por más que ___ convencerlo, no cambió de opinión. (intentar)
q_gram_c1_01_005.explanation: 'Por más que' (no matter come molto) è a concessive conjunction quello triggers il/la congiuntivo. Poiché il/la main clause è in il/la passato remoto ('no cambió'), il/la congiuntivo imperfetto 'intentara' è necessario in il/la subordinate clause.

q_gram_c1_01_006.question: Ojalá que los dirigentes ___ una solución antes de la crisis. (encontrar, trapassato congiuntivo, ellos form)
q_gram_c1_01_006.explanation: 'Ojalá que' con il/la trapassato congiuntivo esprime a regretful wish about a past event quello did not happen. Il/la trapassato congiuntivo è formed con hubieran + participio passato.
q_gram_c1_01_006.conjugation_info: encontrar (pluperfect subjunctive): hubiera encontrado, hubieras encontrado, hubiera encontrado, hubiéramos encontrado, hubierais encontrado, hubieran encontrado

q_gram_c1_01_007.question: Habla con tanta autoridad como si ___ un experto en la materia. (ser)
q_gram_c1_01_007.explanation: Dopo 'como si', solo il/la imperfetto o trapassato congiuntivo è grammatically corretto. Poiché il/la comparison è about an ongoing unreal situation (he è not actually an expert), il/la congiuntivo imperfetto 'fuera' è il/la corretto choice.

q_gram_c1_01_008.question: Perhaps loro sarebbe avere arrived on tempo if il/la train hadn't been delayed.
q_gram_c1_01_008.correct: Quizás hubieran llegado a tiempo si el tren no se hubiera retrasado.
wrong: Quizás llegaran a tiempo si el tren no se retrasara.
Tal vez llegarían a tiempo si el tren no se retrasó.
Quizás habrían llegado a tiempo si el tren no se retrasaría.
q_gram_c1_01_008.explanation: 'Quizás' con a past counterfactual uses il/la trapassato congiuntivo. Il/la si-clause anche takes il/la trapassato congiuntivo ('hubiera retrasado'). 'Quizás hubieran llegado' è preferred over 'habrían llegado' in formale registers quando expressing doubt.

q_gram_c1_01_009.question: Aunque se lo ___ mil veces, jamás lo habría creído. (decir, trapassato congiuntivo, forma nosotros)
q_gram_c1_01_009.explanation: Il/la concessive 'aunque' con a counterfactual past situation requires il/la trapassato congiuntivo. Il/la forma nosotros di il/la trapassato congiuntivo di 'decir' è 'hubiéramos dicho', using il/la irregolare participio passato 'dicho'.
q_gram_c1_01_009.conjugation_info: decir (pluperfect subjunctive): hubiera dicho, hubieras dicho, hubiera dicho, hubiéramos dicho, hubierais dicho, hubieran dicho

q_gram_c1_01_010.question: Por más que se esforzara, nunca lograba satisfacer las expectativas de su mentor.
q_gram_c1_01_010.correct: No matter how hard he tried, he never managed to meet his mentor's expectations.
wrong: The more he tried, the more he met his mentor's expectations.
Even though he tried hard, he always satisfied his mentor's expectations.
However much effort he makes, he will never meet his mentor's expectations.
q_gram_c1_01_010.explanation: 'Por más que' + congiuntivo imperfetto esprime a concessive significato: despite repeated efforts, il/la result era sempre il/la same. Il/la imperfetto tenses ('esforzara', 'lograba') indicate a habitual past situation.

q_gram_c1_02_001.question: Apenas hubo ___ la noticia, salió corriendo hacia la estación. (oír, pretérito anterior)
q_gram_c1_02_001.explanation: Il/la pretérito anterior (hubo + participio passato) si usa dopo temporal conjunctions like 'apenas' (as soon as) per indicare an action completed immediately prima another past action. Il/la participio di 'oír' è 'oído'.
q_gram_c1_02_001.conjugation_info: oír (pretérito anterior): hube oído, hubiste oído, hubo oído, hubimos oído, hubisteis oído, hubieron oído

q_gram_c1_02_002.question: No bien ___ terminado el discurso, el público estalló en aplausos. (haber, pretérito anterior)
q_gram_c1_02_002.explanation: 'No bien' (no sooner) triggers il/la pretérito anterior, quale uses il/la passato remoto di 'haber' + participio passato. 'Hubo terminado' indica il/la speech ended immediately prima il/la audience erupted in applause.

q_gram_c1_02_003.question: Donde ___ leyes, los ciudadanos estarán protegidos. (haber, future congiuntivo)
q_gram_c1_02_003.explanation: Il/la future congiuntivo ('hubiere') survives in legal e proverbial lingua. In questo legal-style sentence, 'donde hubiere leyes' significa 'wherever lì may essere laws'. In modern everyday Spagnolo, il/la congiuntivo presente 'haya' sarebbe essere used instead.

q_gram_c1_02_004.question: In cosa contexts does il/la pretérito anterior (hubo cantado) appear in modern Spagnolo?
q_gram_c1_02_004.correct: Almost exclusively in literary texts, after temporal conjunctions like apenas, en cuanto, no bien, tan pronto como
wrong: In everyday spoken Spanish to express recently completed actions
In formal business correspondence as a replacement for the preterite
In journalism to describe breaking news events
q_gram_c1_02_004.explanation: Il/la pretérito anterior è virtually extinct in spoken Spagnolo e rare even in writing. Quando esso does appear, esso follows temporal conjunctions (apenas, en cuanto, no bien, tan pronto como) e indica immediate anteriority a a passato remoto action. In modern usage, il/la simple passato remoto tipicamente replaces esso.

q_gram_c1_02_005.question: Quien ___ de buena fe, será protegido por la ley. (obrar, future congiuntivo)
q_gram_c1_02_005.explanation: Il/la future congiuntivo ('obrare') si usa in legal texts e fixed expressions. 'Quien obrare de buena fe' è a legal formula significato 'whoever shall act in good faith'. In modern non-legal Spagnolo, il/la congiuntivo presente 'obre' sarebbe essere used.
q_gram_c1_02_005.conjugation_info: obrar (future subjunctive): obrare, obrares, obrare, obráremos, obrareis, obraren

q_gram_c1_02_006.question: Apenas hubo ___ la puerta, se dio cuenta de que había olvidado las llaves dentro. (cerrar, pretérito anterior)
q_gram_c1_02_006.explanation: In il/la pretérito anterior construction 'hubo + participio passato', il/la participio di 'cerrar' è 'cerrado'. Questo tense marks il/la immediately preceding action prima il/la main passato remoto verbo 'se dio cuenta'.

q_gram_c1_02_007.question: Whoever shall violate questo provision sarà essere subject a penalties.
q_gram_c1_02_007.correct: Quien contraviniere esta disposición quedará sujeto a sanciones.
wrong: Quien contravenga esta disposición queda sujeto a sanciones.
Quien contravendría esta disposición estaría sujeto a sanciones.
Quien contravino esta disposición fue sujeto a sanciones.
q_gram_c1_02_007.explanation: In legal Spagnolo, il/la future congiuntivo ('contraviniere') si usa per hypothetical future actions in legal provisions. Questo mirrors il/la archaic Inglese construction 'whoever shall violate'. Il/la modern equivalent sarebbe use il/la congiuntivo presente 'contravenga'.

q_gram_c1_02_008.question: En cuanto hubo ___ el documento, lo envió por correo certificado. (firmar, pretérito anterior)
q_gram_c1_02_008.explanation: Dopo 'en cuanto' (as soon as), il/la pretérito anterior 'hubo firmado' esprime quello il/la signing era completed immediately prima il/la sending. Il/la participio passato di 'firmar' è regolare: 'firmado'.

q_gram_c1_02_009.question: Adonde fueres, haz lo que vieres.
q_gram_c1_02_009.correct: Wherever you may go, do as you may see (done there). / When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
wrong: Wherever you went, do what you saw.
Where you will go, do what you will see.
If you go away, do what you are told.
q_gram_c1_02_009.explanation: Questo proverb uses il/la future congiuntivo ('fueres', 'vieres'), quale survives in fixed sayings. Esso è il/la Spagnolo equivalent di 'Quando in Rome, do as il/la Romans do'. Il/la future congiuntivo qui esprime hypothetical future situations in a timeless, proverbial way.

q_gram_c1_02_010.question: Si así lo ___ el tribunal, se procederá al embargo de los bienes. (disponer, future congiuntivo, forma él)
q_gram_c1_02_010.explanation: In legal register, il/la future congiuntivo 'dispusiere' si usa in condizionale clauses referring a potential future rulings. Il/la radice comes da il/la irregolare passato remoto 'dispuso' → 'dispusier-' + future congiuntivo endings.
q_gram_c1_02_010.conjugation_info: disponer (future subjunctive): dispusiere, dispusieres, dispusiere, dispusiéremos, dispusiereis, dispusieren

q_gram_c1_03_001.question: De ___ la verdad, no habría aceptado el trabajo. (saber)
q_gram_c1_03_001.explanation: 'De + perfect infinito' replaces 'si + trapassato congiuntivo' in a more concise, literary construction. 'De haber sabido' = 'Si hubiera sabido' (Aveva I known). Il/la perfect infinito (haber + participio) è obbligatorio per past counterfactuals.

q_gram_c1_03_002.question: Si hubiera estudiado más, ahora ___ un mejor puesto. (tener)
q_gram_c1_03_002.explanation: Questo è un mixed condizionale: il/la si-clause si riferisce a il/la past (trapassato congiuntivo 'hubiera estudiado') mentre il/la main clause si riferisce a a present consequence (condizionale 'tendría'). Questo mixing di tempo frames è characteristic di C1-level grammar.

q_gram_c1_03_003.question: Cosa è a 'mixed condizionale' in spagnolo, e quando è esso used?
q_gram_c1_03_003.correct: A conditional sentence where the si-clause and the main clause refer to different time frames, such as a past condition with a present result
wrong: A conditional that mixes indicative and subjunctive moods in the same clause
A sentence that uses both 'si' and 'cuando' as conditional markers
A conditional that combines two different subjects in the if-clause
q_gram_c1_03_003.explanation: Mixed conditionals break il/la typical tempo-frame pairing. Per esempio, 'Si hubiera nacido en España (past), hablaría español perfectamente (present)' mixes a past unreal condition con a present unreal result. Questo è un sophisticated structure tested a C1 level.

q_gram_c1_03_004.question: Si no ___ tan orgulloso, le habría pedido disculpas hace tiempo. (ser, congiuntivo imperfetto, forma él)
q_gram_c1_03_004.explanation: Questo è another mixed condizionale: il/la si-clause descrive an ongoing character trait (congiuntivo imperfetto 'fuera' = if he weren't so proud) e il/la result clause si riferisce a il/la past (condizionale perfect 'habría pedido'). Il/la congiuntivo imperfetto si usa perché il/la condition è about a persistent state.
q_gram_c1_03_004.conjugation_info: ser (imperfect subjunctive): fuera, fueras, fuera, fuéramos, fuerais, fueran

q_gram_c1_03_005.question: De no ___ por tu ayuda, nunca habríamos terminado a tiempo. (ser)
q_gram_c1_03_005.explanation: 'De no ser por' è a fixed expression significato 'if esso weren't per' o 'erano esso not per'. Unlike other 'de + infinito' constructions replacing si-clauses, questo expression uses il/la simple infinito 'ser' regardless di tempo reference, perché esso è a set frase.

q_gram_c1_03_006.question: Yo que tú, no ___ en ese negocio. (invertir, condizionale, forma yo)
q_gram_c1_03_006.explanation: 'Yo que tú' (if I erano tu) è an implied condizionale quello omits il/la si-clause entirely. Il/la main clause uses il/la condizionale tense. Questo colloquial construction è equivalent a 'Si yo fuera tú, no invertiría en ese negocio'.
q_gram_c1_03_006.conjugation_info: invertir (conditional): invertiría, invertirías, invertiría, invertiríamos, invertiríais, invertirían

q_gram_c1_03_007.question: Con un poco más de experiencia, ___ haber conseguido el puesto. (poder)
q_gram_c1_03_007.explanation: 'Con + sostantivo frase' può replace a si-clause per esprimere an implied condition. 'Con un poco más de experiencia' = 'Si tuviera un poco más de experiencia'. Il/la main clause uses il/la condizionale 'podría' as expected.

q_gram_c1_03_008.question: Aveva esso not been per il/la interpreter, il/la negotiations sarebbe avere failed.
q_gram_c1_03_008.correct: De no haber sido por el intérprete, las negociaciones habrían fracasado.
wrong: Si no fuera por el intérprete, las negociaciones fracasaron.
Sin el intérprete, las negociaciones fracasaban.
De no ser el intérprete, las negociaciones hubieran fracasado.
q_gram_c1_03_008.explanation: 'De no haber sido por' è il/la past version di 'de no ser por', using il/la perfect infinito per a past counterfactual. Il/la main clause uses il/la condizionale perfect 'habrían fracasado' per esprimere il/la unrealized consequence.

q_gram_c1_03_009.question: Si ella no ___ tanto, habría disfrutado más del viaje. (quejarse, trapassato congiuntivo, ella form)
q_gram_c1_03_009.explanation: Il/la trapassato congiuntivo di il/la reflexive verbo 'quejarse' è 'se hubiera quejado'. In il/la si-clause di a past counterfactual, il/la reflexive pronome 'se' precedes il/la auxiliary 'hubiera'.
q_gram_c1_03_009.conjugation_info: quejarse (pluperfect subjunctive): me hubiera quejado, te hubieras quejado, se hubiera quejado, nos hubiéramos quejado, os hubierais quejado, se hubieran quejado

q_gram_c1_03_010.question: De haberlo previsto, habríamos tomado las medidas oportunas con suficiente antelación.
q_gram_c1_03_010.correct: Had we foreseen it, we would have taken the appropriate measures well in advance.
wrong: If we foresaw it, we would take the appropriate measures in advance.
By having foreseen it, we took the appropriate measures well in advance.
Upon foreseeing it, we had taken the necessary measures sufficiently early.
q_gram_c1_03_010.explanation: 'De haberlo previsto' è a literary replacement per 'Si lo hubiéramos previsto' (aveva we foreseen esso). Il/la perfect infinito 'haber previsto' indica a past counterfactual. 'Con suficiente antelación' significa 'well in advance'.

q_gram_c1_04_001.question: El orador señaló, ___, que la reforma era imprescindible. (dicho esto → formale discourse marker, participio presente di decir + esto)
q_gram_c1_04_001.explanation: 'Dicho esto' (quello said/having said questo) è a discourse marker using an absolute participio construction. Esso functions as a transitional frase in formale speech e writing, linking a previous point a a new assertion.
q_gram_c1_04_001.conjugation_info: decir (past participle): dicho — used in absolute participle constructions: dicho esto, dicho lo cual, dicho de otro modo

q_gram_c1_04_002.question: ___, las cifras demuestran que la economía se está recuperando. (en cualquier caso)
q_gram_c1_04_002.explanation: 'En cualquier caso' (in any case) è a formale discourse marker used a introduce a conclusion quello holds regardless di il/la preceding arguments. Mentre 'en todo caso' e 'de cualquier forma' sono similar, 'en cualquier caso' è il/la la maggior parte formale register option.

q_gram_c1_04_003.question: No hemos recibido respuesta; ___, debemos seguir adelante con el proyecto. (no obstante)
q_gram_c1_04_003.explanation: 'No obstante' (notwithstanding/nevertheless) è a formale adversative connector quello introduces a contrasting idea. Esso è spesso used in written e academic Spagnolo, e its placement dopo il/la semicolon è typical di formale prose.

q_gram_c1_04_004.question: Cosa è il/la difference between 'por consiguiente' e 'en resumidas cuentas' as discourse markers?
q_gram_c1_04_004.correct: 'Por consiguiente' introduces a logical consequence, while 'en resumidas cuentas' introduces a summary or conclusion of everything discussed
wrong: Both are interchangeable and express the same logical relationship
'Por consiguiente' is informal while 'en resumidas cuentas' is formal
'Por consiguiente' introduces a contrast while 'en resumidas cuentas' introduces a cause
q_gram_c1_04_004.explanation: 'Por consiguiente' (consequently/quindi) establishes a cause-effect relationship, mentre 'en resumidas cuentas' (in short/tutti things considered) synthesizes multiple points into a final assessment. Loro serve different textual functions: logical deduction vs. summarization.

q_gram_c1_04_005.question: La inversión fue arriesgada; ___, los beneficios superaron las expectativas. (ahora bien → tuttavia/now then, formale register)
q_gram_c1_04_005.explanation: 'Ahora bien' (tuttavia/now then) è a formale discourse marker quello introduces a qualification, nuance, o contrasting perspective a cosa era just stated. Esso signals a shift in il/la argument senza full contradiction.
q_gram_c1_04_005.conjugation_info: Common formal discourse markers: ahora bien (however), dicho esto (that said), a este respecto (in this regard), en resumidas cuentas (in short)

q_gram_c1_04_006.question: ___, la propuesta carece de fundamento jurídico suficiente. (a este respecto)
q_gram_c1_04_006.explanation: 'A este respecto' (in questo regard) è a formale discourse marker quello connects il/la current statement a a previously mentioned topic. Esso è more precise than 'al respecto' e signals il/la writer è addressing a specific point.

q_gram_c1_04_007.question: Having said quello, we deve consider il/la environmental impact di il/la project.
q_gram_c1_04_007.correct: Dicho esto, debemos considerar el impacto medioambiental del proyecto.
wrong: Diciendo eso, debemos considerar el impacto ambiental del proyecto.
Habiendo dicho, tenemos que considerar el impacto ecológico del proyecto.
Esto dicho, necesitamos considerar el impacto del medioambiente del proyecto.
q_gram_c1_04_007.explanation: 'Dicho esto' è il/la standard Spagnolo discourse marker per 'having said quello / quello said'. Esso uses il/la absolute participio construction. 'Diciendo eso' sarebbe essere unnatural in questo context as a discourse connector.

q_gram_c1_04_008.question: Las medidas adoptadas fueron insuficientes; ___, no se puede negar que representaron un primer paso. (con todo)
q_gram_c1_04_008.explanation: 'Con todo' (nevertheless/even so) è a formale concessive connector quello acknowledges il/la preceding point mentre introducing a mitigating counterargument. Esso è less comune than 'sin embargo' ma preferred in certain academic e literary registers.

q_gram_c1_04_009.question: En resumidas cuentas, el proyecto ha sido un éxito rotundo a pesar de las dificultades iniciales.
q_gram_c1_04_009.correct: In short, the project has been a resounding success despite the initial difficulties.
wrong: In any case, the project was a success in spite of initial problems.
To summarize the accounts, the project succeeded despite early challenges.
As a result, the project turned out to be completely successful despite difficulties.
q_gram_c1_04_009.explanation: 'En resumidas cuentas' (in short/a sum up) è a summarizing discourse marker. 'Rotundo' significa 'resounding/emphatic'. Il/la frase signals quello il/la speaker è wrapping up il loro argument con a definitive assessment.

q_gram_c1_04_010.question: Sea ___ fuere, la decisión ya ha sido tomada y no hay vuelta atrás. (como, future congiuntivo di ser)
q_gram_c1_04_010.explanation: 'Sea como fuere' (essere quello as esso may) è a fixed concessive expression quello uses il/la future congiuntivo 'fuere'. Il/la parola needed a complete questo set frase è 'como'. Questo expression survives in formale speech despite il/la general obsolescence di il/la future congiuntivo.
q_gram_c1_04_010.conjugation_info: ser (future subjunctive): fuere, fueres, fuere, fuéremos, fuereis, fueren — survives only in fixed expressions like 'sea como fuere'

q_gram_c1_05_001.question: En un correo formal a un desconocido: 'Le ___ que me informara sobre los requisitos de admisión.' (agradecer, condizionale, forma yo)
q_gram_c1_05_001.explanation: In formale written correspondence a someone unknown, il/la condizionale 'agradecería' softens il/la request, making esso more polite than il/la present o future indicativo. Questo register awareness è crucial a C1 level. 'Le agradecería que...' è il/la standard formale request formula.

q_gram_c1_05_002.question: En un texto académico, es preferible escribir: 'Se ___ que los resultados confirman la hipótesis.' (observar)
q_gram_c1_05_002.explanation: Academic Spagnolo uses il/la impersonal 'se' construction ('se observa que') a maintain objectivity e distance. Il/la first persona ('observo') è generally avoided in academic writing in spagnolo, unlike in inglese dove 'I' o 'we' may essere acceptable.

q_gram_c1_05_003.question: Cosa è il/la key difference between 'tú', 'usted', e 'vos' in terms di register e regional usage?
q_gram_c1_05_003.correct: 'Tú' is informal and used in most of Spain and Latin America; 'usted' is formal and universal; 'vos' is informal and used in Argentina, Uruguay, Central America, and parts of Colombia
wrong: 'Tú' is used in Spain only; 'usted' is used in Latin America; 'vos' is archaic and no longer used
'Tú' and 'vos' are identical in meaning and conjugation; 'usted' is only for elderly speakers
'Vos' is more formal than 'usted' and is used in diplomatic contexts
q_gram_c1_05_003.explanation: Il/la three-way distinction reflects both formality e geography. 'Vos' è not archaic ma actively used da millions di speakers in il/la Río de la Plata region, Central America, e elsewhere. Ogni form triggers different verbo conjugations, particularly in il/la present tense e imperativo.

q_gram_c1_05_004.question: En Argentina, la forma voseante del presente indicativo de 'tener' es: Vos ___. (tener, voseo, indicativo presente)
q_gram_c1_05_004.explanation: In Argentine voseo, indicativo presente forms stress il/la final syllable: vos tenés, vos querés, vos podés. Il/la accent falls on il/la final -és (per -er verbs). Questo differs da both 'tú tienes' e 'vosotros tenéis'.
q_gram_c1_05_004.conjugation_info: tener (voseo present indicative): vos tenés — compare: tú tienes, vosotros tenéis

q_gram_c1_05_005.question: En una carta de reclamación formal: 'Por la presente, ___ mi más enérgica protesta ante la situación descrita.' (formular)
q_gram_c1_05_005.explanation: In formale complaint letters, 'por la presente' (hereby) è seguito da il/la indicativo presente a make a formale declaration. 'Formulo mi protesta' è a performative utterance dove il/la act di writing constitutes il/la act di protesting. Il/la condizionale sarebbe weaken il/la complaint.

q_gram_c1_05_006.question: Vos ___ venir cuando quieras. (poder, voseo imperativo)
q_gram_c1_05_006.explanation: In voseo regions, 'vos podés' replaces 'tú puedes'. Il/la voseo imperativo di -er verbs keeps il/la stress on il/la last syllable con a written accent. In informale Argentine speech, questo form è standard.
q_gram_c1_05_006.conjugation_info: poder (voseo present): vos podés — voseo imperative forms differ: vos hablá (hablar), vos comé (comer), vos decí (decir)

q_gram_c1_05_007.question: Sentá ___ a mi lado, por favor. (vos, voseo, reflexive imperativo di sentarse)
q_gram_c1_05_007.explanation: Il/la reflexive pronome per 'vos' è 'te', il/la same as per 'tú'. Il/la voseo imperativo di 'sentarse' è 'sentate' (spesso written as two words in some dialects: 'sentá te'). Il/la reflexive pronome does not change between tuteo e voseo.

q_gram_c1_05_008.question: I sarebbe essere grateful if tu potrebbe send me il/la requested information a il tuo earliest convenience.
q_gram_c1_05_008.correct: Le agradecería que me enviara la información solicitada a la mayor brevedad posible.

q_gram_c1_10_002.question: Es imposible ___ sin que alguien se oponga. (aprobar la ley → infinito replacing que + congiuntivo)

q_gram_c1_10_004.question: Cosa è an 'absolute participio clause' (cláusula de participio absoluto) in spagnolo?
q_gram_c1_10_004.correct: A subordinate clause with a past participle and its own subject, independent from the main clause, functioning as a temporal or causal adverbial

q_gram_c1_10_009.question: Dicho lo cual, el embajador abandonó la sala sin mediar más explicaciones.

q_gram_c1_11_001.question: Fue María ___ resolvió el problema, no Pedro. (relative pronome per cleft sentence)

q_gram_c1_11_008.question: Cosa I really want è per them a understand il/la severity di il/la situation.

q_gram_c1_11_009.question: Ni siquiera el director ___ capaz de resolver semejante dilema ético. (ser, condizionale, forma él — focus particle 'ni siquiera')

q_gram_c1_11_010.question: Lo que me resulta verdaderamente incomprensible es que nadie haya denunciado semejante irregularidad.

q_gram_c1_12_001.question: En España se dice 'vosotros habláis', pero en Latinoamérica se dice 'ustedes ___'. (hablar, indicativo presente, ustedes form)

q_gram_c1_13_001.question: El profesor dijo que el examen ___ el lunes siguiente. (ser, reported speech backshift)
q_gram_c1_13_001.explanation: In reported speech, quando il/la reporting verbo è in il/la past ('dijo'), il/la original future 'será' shifts a il/la condizionale 'sería'. q_gram_c1_14_005.question: La primera propuesta fue rechazada; la segunda, en cambio, ___ aprobada por unanimidad. (ser, pretérito indefinido — ellipsis di 'propuesta fue')

q_gram_c1_14_006.question: Los investigadores presentaron sus hallazgos. ___, el público pudo formular preguntas. (a continuación — sequential connector)

q_gram_c1_14_010.question: El estudio se centró en tres variables, a saber: la edad, el nivel educativo y el ingreso mensual. El conector 'a saber' cumple una función ___. (catafórica/cataphoric, explicativa/explanatory)

q_gram_c1_15_005.question: *Si tendría* más dinero, compraría una casa. → Si ___ más dinero, compraría una casa. (tener, corretto form dopo 'si')

q_gram_c1_15_008.question: Il/la conference era molto interesting; I realized quello I need a improve my presentation skills.
